why: परिष्वक्ता is the regular feminine past participle (Sita embraced on his chest); grammar and metre fine.
परिष्वक्तो (= परिष्वक्तः, nom. masc. participle) agrees with सुग्रीवः ... महाभुजः; fine.
वैदेह्याश्च is वैदेह्याः + च with regular sandhi; sense (dismissal of Vaidehi) fits the contents list.
सुग्रीवेति is सुग्रीव + इति (calling out 'Sugriva' again and again); fine.
प्रतिगृह्यसे is the 2nd sg. passive ('you are not accepted by suitors'); grammar and sense fine.
प्रतिगृह्ण is not a standard imperative (expected प्रतिगृहाण/प्रतिगृह्णीष्व) but the 8-syllable pada needs exactly this length, so it may be an epic irregularity of the edition.
राक्षसाय is the dative ('gave a boon to the raksasa'); fine.
भगवन्न ददामि is भगवन् + न with the n written joined; regular typing of the edition.
Only the pada-boundary marker follows कृताञ्जलिः; the word itself is fine.
भगवतो (= भगवतः, genitive) fits 'the southern quarter of the Lord'; fine.
सहस्रारं 'thousand-spoked' qualifies चक्रं; a correct compound.
सहस्राक्ष इवासुरान् (Indra destroying the asuras) is correct in form and metre.
राक्षसेन्द्र is the vocative before a pada marker; fine.
भगवतः is the genitive agreeing with देवदेवस्य; fine.
भगवन्तः is the nominative plural matching सशिष्याः; fine.
चतुर्दशसु वर्षेषु is a correct locative plural ('when fourteen years have ended'); fine.
सुग्रीवमा runs the vocative सुग्रीव and the prohibitive मा together; a space is missing.
चतुर्दन्तैः 'four-tusked' qualifies वारणैः; fine.
सुग्रीवस्त्वं is सुग्रीवः + त्वं with regular sandhi; fine.

suggest: सा च दैवतकार्येण गता वर्षं चतुर्दशम्
why: दैवत कार्येण is one instrumental compound दैवतकार्येण; a stray space splits it. चतुर्दशम् itself is fine.
चतुर्दन्तं 'four-tusked' describes the elephant; fine.
Only the pada marker follows चकार; the line is fine.
नरश्रेष्ठौ is the dual, agreeing with सम्प्राप्तौ and वीरौ in the next line; fine.
Only the pada marker follows महीतले; fine.
विभीषणे is a locative in a list of locatives (सुग्रीवे, वानरेन्द्रे, राक्षसेन्द्रे); fine.
करिष्याम is the 1st plural (the sons speaking); a regular epic form.
महात्माथ is महात्मा + अथ; fine.
Only the pada marker follows विद्यते; fine.
करिष्यामः 1st plural ('we shall make shade') fits the Brahmins speaking; fine.
करिष्यावो is the 1st dual (Rama and Lakshmana), matching आदेक्ष्यावो in the next line; fine.
संयुगेषु locative plural 'in battles' is correct.
कैकेय्याहं is कैकेय्या + अहं with regular sandhi; fine.
Only the pada marker follows मैथिली; fine.
विशेषश्च is विशेषः + च; fine.
विशेषज्ञः 'discerning' is a correct epithet of Rama; fine.
वानरास्ते is वानराः + ते; fine.
वानरा (= वानराः before the pada marker) nominative plural with बहवः; fine.
कौसल्यायै dative 'gave to Kausalya', parallel to सुमित्रायै in the next line; fine.
कौसल्यायां locative 'towards Kausalya as towards a mother'; fine.
कौसल्यायाः genitive with कथयन्त्याः; fine.
Only the pada marker follows रोचते; fine.
परन्तपाः vocative plural addressing the monkeys, parallel to हरियूथपाः; fine.
दुरात्मन् is the vocative; fine.
गोपुराट्ट प्रतोलीषु is one locative compound; a stray space splits it. विविधासु itself is fine.
Only the pada marker follows सर्वतो; fine.
दुरात्मनोः is the genitive dual, matching मधुकैटभयोः ... वर्तमानयोः in the next line; fine.
रघुनन्दनौ dual with प्राञ्जली and ऊचतू (visarga before र- lengthens the vowel); fine.
अर्थथ is no word; the sense 'you should permit it' needs अर्हथ (ह typed as थ). महायज्ञं is fine.
दशरतः has त for थ in Dasharatha's name and the compound दशरथस्नुषाम् is split; fix the akshara.
ततस्तेषु प्रयातेषु is a correct locative absolute; fine.
The subject is masculine nominative (हनूमान्, महातेजाः), so मारुतात्मजः; final visarga dropped.
राक्षसेश्वरे is a locative absolute with तस्मिन् प्रस्थिते; fine.
सहलक्ष्मणं accusative agreeing with पतिं; fine.
सहलक्ष्मणे locative agreeing with रामे ... सुग्रीवे; fine.
सहलक्ष्मण is the vocative addressing Rama; fine.
Only the pada marker follows निहत्य; fine.
Only the pada marker follows पपात; fine.
समागते locative absolute with षष्ठेऽहनि; fine.
समागमः 'meeting' is the noun subject with व्यजायत; fine.
समागधः is a name in the edition's list of jesters; names are not changed.
